description: issue #685 (slice I6): the multiline `on_click ... end on_click` form requires its closing label to match the block-head; closing an `on_click` block with `end when` is rejected at PARSE stage with `ol-mismatched-end` (spec/interaction-events.md's event-end grammar; spec/error-model.md's `ol-mismatched-end`; the `END_LABELS` registration C2 (#664) added for `on_click`). Because the parse fails, `execute()` bails before running anything, so no events are emitted.

diagnostics.message: this when doesn't close the block that is open. did you mean on_click?
